protocol.name: wc_gpu_fence_v1

description.summary: wait for a GPU frame before reading a shared section

protocol.description:
The dma-buf path of docs/waycompose-design.md §104 hands the compositor a wl_shm pool whose memory is a section the guest's GPU process writes. The GPU work that writes a frame is numbered by the client's Vulkan driver (sv-icd) when it is submitted, and the GPU process writes "completed up to n" into a small named section, the fence record, when the work is done (§104.11).
wc-proxy sends wait(record, n) immediately before the wl_surface.commit of such a buffer, on an object it binds for that one message and destroys right after. The compositor does not process the commit until the record says completed >= n, or a short limit has passed.
Bound by wc-proxy only; it never offers this global to its clients.

request.name: wait

description.summary: wait until record says completed >= seq

request.description: record is a section name (Local\sv-fence-...) or, on a local run, a /dev/shm path; its basename starts with "sv-fence-". It holds "SVFENCE1" and then completed, a little-endian u64. seq is seq_hi * 2^32 + seq_lo.
